question: The 'National Pension Scheme' ('NPS') is regulated by: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (26/07/2021) Shift 1)
options: PFRDA
IRDA
NPDA
PCRADA
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is PFRDA

Explanation:
The National Pension Scheme (NPS) is a government-sponsored pension scheme designed to provide retirement income to Indian citizens. It is regulated by the Pension Fund Regulatory and Development Authority (PFRDA), which was established in 2003 and given statutory status in 2013. NPS is open to central and state government employees, as well as all Indian citizens aged 18 to 70. The scheme offers two types of accounts: Tier I (pension account) with withdrawal restrictions, and Tier II (voluntary savings account) with more flexibility. Investments under NPS are allocated across different asset classes (E, C, G, A) based on the subscriber's choice. PFRDA oversees the scheme, sets regulations, and ensures protection of investor interests.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Who regulates NPS? → PFRDA
☛ When was PFRDA established? → 2003
☛ When did PFRDA get statutory status? → 2013
☛ What is Tier I account in NPS? → Pension account (restricted withdrawal)
☛ What is the minimum age for NPS? → 18 years (maximum 70 years)
question_hi: राष्ट्रीय पेंशन योजना (NPS) किसके द्वारा विनियमित है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (26/07/2021) Shift 1)
options_hi: PFRDA
IRDA
NPDA
PCRADA
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है PFRDA

Explanation:
राष्ट्रीय पेंशन योजना (NPS) भारत सरकार की एक पेंशन योजना है, जो नागरिकों को सेवानिवृत्ति के बाद आय सुरक्षा प्रदान करती है। इसे पेंशन निधि विनियामक और विकास प्राधिकरण (PFRDA) द्वारा विनियमित किया जाता है। PFRDA की स्थापना 2003 में हुई थी और इसे 2013 में वैधानिक दर्जा दिया गया। NPS में केंद्र और राज्य सरकार के कर्मचारी, साथ ही सभी भारतीय नागरिक (18-70 वर्ष) शामिल हो सकते हैं। योजना दो प्रकार के खाते प्रदान करती है: टियर I (पेंशन खाता) और टियर II (स्वैच्छिक बचत खाता)। NPS के तहत निवेश को विभिन्न एसेट क्लास (E, C, G, A) में विभाजित किया जाता है। PFRDA योजना की देखरेख, नियम निर्धारण और निवेशकों के हितों की रक्षा करता है।

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:

☛ NPS में न्यूनतम आयु सीमा क्या है? → 18 वर्ष (अधिकतम 70 वर्ष)

question: When was the Prime Minister Sansad Adarsh ​​Gram Yojana started? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (04/02/2021) Shift 2)
options: 19 May 2015
11 October 2014
28 August 2014
23 July 2010
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is 11 October 2014

Explanation:
The Prime Minister's Sansad Adarsh Gram Yojana (PMSAGY) was launched on 11 October 2014. The scheme aims at developing villages through Members of Parliament, who adopt one village in their constituency to transform it into an ideal model village. It focuses on rural development, sanitation, education, health, and infrastructure. After its launch in 2014, modifications were made in 2015 and 2016. Under this scheme, each MP selects a village to develop holistically, involving Panchayati Raj institutions and local communities. The target is to create self-sufficient and sustainable villages.

☛ Main objective of PMSAGY? → Model village development by MPs
☛ How many villages per MP? → One (initially)

☛ Revisions in scheme? → Modifications in 2015 and 2016
question_hi: प्रधानमंत्री सांसद आदर्श ग्राम योजना कब शुरू की गई थी? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (04/02/2021) Shift 2)

28 अगस्त 2014

Explanation:
प्रधानमंत्री सांसद आदर्श ग्राम योजना (PMSAGY) 11 अक्टूबर 2014 को लॉन्च की गई थी। इस योजना का उद्देश्य सांसदों द्वारा गाँवों का विकास करना है, जिसमें वे अपने संसदीय क्षेत्र में एक आदर्श गाँव चुनते हैं। यह योजना ग्रामीण विकास, स्वच्छता, शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य और बुनियादी ढाँचे पर केंद्रित है। 2014 में शुरू होने के बाद, 2015 और 2016 में इसमें संशोधन किए गए। योजना के तहत, प्रत्येक सांसद अपने निर्वाचन क्षेत्र में एक गाँव गोद लेता है और उसे आदर्श गाँव के रूप में विकसित करता है। यह योजना पंचायती राज संस्थाओं और स्थानीय समुदायों की भागीदारी को प्रोत्साहित करती है।

question: Which of the following functions cannot be performed by NBFCs ? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (01/04/2021) Shift 1)
options: Providing loans
Accepting demand deposits
Making investments
Acquisition of shares
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Accepting demand deposits

Explanation:
NBFC (Non-Banking Financial Company) is registered under the Reserve Bank of India Act, 1956 and plays a limited role in banking functions. NBFC can provide loans, make investments, and acquire shares, but it cannot accept demand deposits. Demand deposits are deposits that can be withdrawn immediately without prior notice, such as current accounts or savings accounts. This function is exclusively given to banks. NBFC can only accept time deposits. This distinction is a key difference between NBFCs and banks.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ Full form of NBFC → Non-Banking Financial Company
☛ Regulator of NBFC → Reserve Bank of India (RBI)
☛ What NBFC cannot do → Accept demand deposits
☛ What NBFC can do → Loans, investments, share acquisition
☛ Main difference between NBFC and bank → Ability to accept demand deposits
question_hi: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा कार्य NBFC द्वारा नहीं किया जा सकता है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (01/04/2021) Shift 1)

मांग जमा स्वीकार करना
निवेश करना
शेयरों का अधिग्रहण
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है मांग जमा स्वीकार करना

Explanation:
NBFC (गैर-बैंकिंग वित्तीय कंपनी) भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक के अधिनियम 1956 के तहत पंजीकृत होती है और बैंकिंग कार्यों में सीमित भूमिका निभाती है। NBFC ऋण प्रदान कर सकती है, निवेश कर सकती है और शेयरों का अधिग्रहण कर सकती है, लेकिन वह मांग जमा स्वीकार नहीं कर सकती। मांग जमा वे जमाएँ होती हैं जिन्हें बिना किसी पूर्व सूचना के तुरंत निकाला जा सकता है, जैसे चालू खाता या बचत खाता। यह कार्य केवल बैंकों को दिया गया है। NBFC केवल सावधि जमा स्वीकार कर सकती है। यह अंतर NBFC और बैंकों के बीच मुख्य अंतर है।

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:

☛ NBFC का नियामक → भारतीय रिज़र्व बैंक (RBI)

question: What is Vidyanjali project? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (08/04/2021) Shift 2)
options: Volunteers in government schools to help scholastic work
Provision for tuition from class 1-8
Computer-aided instruction in government schools
Giving free uniform and clothes to government school children
solution:

Explanation:
The Vidyanjali project is an initiative by the Government of India that encourages volunteers to assist in scholastic activities in government and aided schools. Its aim is to improve the quality of school education through enhanced community participation. Volunteers can help with teaching, skill development, sports, and co-curricular activities. The program is under the Ministry of Education and aligns with the National Education Policy 2020. Vidyanjali focuses on volunteering, not on tuition, computer instruction, or uniform distribution.

☛ Which policy does Vidyanjali align with? → National Education Policy 2020

question: Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyan is a flagship programme by the Government of India, as of September 2020. Which of the following is NOT a feature of it?  (RRB NTPC CBT-I (24/07/2021) Shift 1)
options: To facilitate the employment of migrant workers who have gone to their home states.
Many projects involving migrant workers have also been initiated for building of roads, highways, etc.
It has been initiated in 11 districts in Mission Mode.
Under this campaign, rural infrastructure would be built with the involvement of migrant workers.
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is It has been initiated in 11 districts in Mission Mode.

Explanation:
The Pradhan Mantri Garib Kalyan Rojgar Abhiyan (PMGKRA) was launched in June 2020 to provide employment to migrant workers who returned to their home states due to the COVID-19 pandemic. It was implemented in 116 districts across the country in Mission Mode, not just 11 districts. The campaign focused on building rural infrastructure through 25 categories of works, including road construction, housing, and water conservation. The scheme was for a duration of 125 days and ensured the involvement of migrant workers. Thus, Option 3 is incorrect.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:

☛ How many districts were covered? → 116 districts
☛ What was the duration of the campaign? → 125 days
☛ Which workers were targeted? → Migrant workers
☛ How many categories of works were included? → 25 categories
question_hi: सितंबर 2020 तक, प्रधानमंत्री गरीब कल्याण रोजगार अभियान भारत सरकार का एक प्रमुख कार्यक्रम था। निम्नलिखित में से कौन सी इसकी विशेषता नहीं है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (24/07/2021) Shift 1)

solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है यह मिशन मोड में 11 जिलों में शुरू किया गया है।

Explanation:
प्रधानमंत्री गरीब कल्याण रोजगार अभियान (PMGKRA) जून 2020 में शुरू किया गया था, जिसका उद्देश्य कोविड-19 महामारी के कारण अपने गृह राज्यों लौटे प्रवासी श्रमिकों को रोजगार प्रदान करना था। यह अभियान 116 जिलों में मिशन मोड में लागू किया गया, न कि 11 जिलों में। इसमें ग्रामीण बुनियादी ढांचे के विकास के लिए 25 श्रेणियों के कार्य शामिल थे, जैसे सड़क निर्माण, आवास, और जल संरक्षण। यह योजना 125 दिनों की अवधि के लिए थी और इसमें प्रवासी श्रमिकों की भागीदारी सुनिश्चित की गई थी। अतः विकल्प 3 गलत है।

question: Which ministry controls the 'Saubhagya Yojana' launched by the Central Government in 2017? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (31/07/2021) Shift 2)
options: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers' Welfare
Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas
Ministry of Power
Ministry of Finance
solution:
Solution: Correct Answer is Ministry of Power

Explanation:
The 'Saubhagya Yojana' (Pradhan Mantri Sahaj Bijli Har Ghar Yojana) was launched by the Central Government in 2017. Its objective was to provide electricity connections to all households in rural and urban areas. The scheme is implemented under the Ministry of Power. Under this scheme, electricity connections were provided free of cost, aiming for 'electricity to every household'. It was executed by the DISCOMs (Power Distribution Companies). Later, the scheme was merged with other schemes, but its administrative control remained with the Ministry of Power. This scheme played a crucial role in increasing electricity access across the country.

Important one-liners for upcoming exams:
☛ When was Saubhagya Yojana launched? → 2017
☛ What is the full name of Saubhagya Yojana? → Pradhan Mantri Sahaj Bijli Har Ghar Yojana
☛ What was provided under Saubhagya Yojana? → Free electricity connections
☛ What was the objective of Saubhagya Yojana? → To provide electricity to all households
☛ Which ministry controls Saubhagya Yojana? → Ministry of Power
question_hi: केंद्र सरकार द्वारा 2017 में शुरू की गई 'सौभाग्य योजना' किस मंत्रालय द्वारा नियंत्रित है? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (31/07/2021) Shift 2)
options_hi: कृषि और किसान कल्याण मंत्रालय
पेट्रोलियम और प्राकृतिक गैस मंत्रालय
विद्युत मंत्रालय
वित्त मंत्रालय
solution_hi:
Solution: सही उत्तर है विद्युत मंत्रालय

question: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana is for: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (27/02/2021) Shift 2)

Explanation:
Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY) is a scheme launched by the Government of India on April 8, 2015. Its objective is to provide funding up to ₹10 lakh to the non-corporate, small business sector. The scheme is specifically designed to offer financial assistance to small entrepreneurs, traders, service providers, and self-employed individuals. question: Who works to make 'Made in India' a label of quality? (RRB NTPC CBT-I (01/03/2021) Shift 2)
options: Annamrita Foundation
National Innovation Foundation
India Brand Equity Foundation
Diya Foundation
solution:

Explanation:
The India Brand Equity Foundation (IBEF) is a trust under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Government of India. It was established in 2003 to promote Indian brands and make 'Made in India' a label of quality. IBEF aims to strengthen the global image of Indian products and services and boost exports. It works across various sectors to highlight the capabilities and quality of Indian industries. The Annamrita Foundation is associated with mid-day meals, while the National Innovation Foundation promotes innovation and entrepreneurship. IBEF specifically focuses on brand equity and quality certification. Its initiatives include creating brand awareness and facilitating trade, thereby positioning India as a quality manufacturing hub.

question: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana was launched on: (RRB NTPC CBT-I (03/03/2021) Shift 2)
